statement: Newton convergence reliability (param 27) requires a smooth, consistent residual, but replacing the natural e^n transition closure with a fixed trip worsens physical model fidelity (param 28). mfoil's transition-station equation IS the natural closure (enforces n(xt)=ncrit via sub-Newton), so freezing turb flags alone leaves an inconsistent equation: Rnorm stalls at ~12.6 (NACA 2412, alpha=2, Re=1e6, trip 5%).
resolution: Separation in TIME (classical TRIZ separation principle) + Principle 11 'beforehand cushioning' / 23 'feedback': during inverse Newton iterations the transition-station equation is REPLACED by the smooth turbulence-onset closure sa2 = ctau_init(U2) at a fixed trip (XFOIL-style), removing the C0 kink from the Jacobian; after shape convergence the natural closure is RESTORED and a direct-mode verification solve confirms the physics (feedback check). Implemented as adapter-level module shims (ADR-0003), vendor untouched.
